description: This file defines two asynchronous functions, getUserCosts and getUserProjectsCosts, which perform complex MongoDB aggregations on a 'llmCosts' model to compute user-specific cost summaries and project-based cost breakdowns, respectively. It exports these functions for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: getUserCosts
methods.description: Aggregates total cost for a user with breakdowns by agent and type, normalizing fields and handling nulls.

methods.name: getUserProjectsCosts
methods.description: Aggregates costs for a user grouped by project, including agent subtotals.
